Got questions?

The answers people want before they buy a depilatory from a brand they don't know yet.

A 140 mL bottle is for repeat body use, not one session. Full legs use more product than underarms or the bikini line. How far a bottle goes depends on the area and how heavily you spray.

Like other depilatory sprays, AERASE has a noticeable scent while it sits. It is not unscented. Wipe with the spatula, then rinse. Do not leave it on longer than 10 minutes.

AERASE is made to dissolve hair on the skin's surface. Coarse or dense hair may need an even coat and the full 10 minutes. Results vary. Always patch test first.

Shaving cuts hair at the surface, so stubble can show sooner. AERASE removes hair down to the skin, so the smooth finish typically lasts longer than a shave. How long depends on your hair and the area. It is not permanent.

Patch test on a small area before treating a larger area. Do not use on broken or irritated skin, the face, genitals or mucous membranes. If burning or irritation occurs, stop, remove the product and rinse thoroughly.

Spray an even layer onto clean, dry skin. Let it sit for 10 minutes. Wipe it away with the included spatula, then rinse. Do not leave it on longer than 10 minutes.

For external use only. Bikini line means the external bikini-line area only.

Try AERASE for 30 days. If it isn't for you, return it for a refund. Orders typically ship in 2–5 days. Single bottles ship for $5.95. Two- and three-bottle bundles and AutoShip orders ship free. Checkout is secure.
